scale_integral_primitive: Integral_1^L log(t)/t dt = (log L)^2/2 for L>=1
uniform_original_scale: For V(s)=C s^-2 exp(-c s/h), B=b/h fixed: weighted potential integral <= C exp(-cB)/(cB), using log(t/B)<=t/B. Positive C,c,h; b<3.
shrinking_inner_scale: For 0<b<h<=3 the same integral >= C exp(-c) (log(h/b))^2/2, by restricting s to[b,h]. This rejects an h-uniform use of condition6.1 when b/h tends to0 for this upper-bound model potential, not the wave theorem or every better actual potential.
temporal_spectral_scope: Known Remark6.2 scalar E has only temporal frequencies0,+1,-1; E_TTT+E_T=0 exactly. Adding temporal band limitation alone to the scalar assumptions does not exclude that existing obstruction. Actual nonlinear wave energy need not be bandlimited.
scope: Two elementary symbolic identities and analytic inequalities; source mechanism/inference, no new PDE result, grade, independent review or Lean proof.
